fact: INE's 2025 continuous multi-purpose survey (IMC) shows 22.7% of people aged 10 and over did not use the internet in the previous three months, 31.2% in rural areas against 20.0% in urban areas.

INE's 2025 survey implies rural internet use of 68.8% (non-use 31.2%) against 80.0% urban (non-use 20.0%) among people aged 10 and over, and 69.3% of rural households with internet against 68.5% urban.
